sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners; and learned AGA for the State-respondents.
2.

The writ petition seeks quashing of the F.I.R. dated 29.12.2023 giving rise to Case Crime No. 48 of 2023, under Sections 498A,323,504,494 I.P.C. and section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District- Hathras.
Manish And 5 Others vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 10 April, 2024

entities.text: Manish And 5 Others vs State Of Up And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned A.G.A has submitted that in the present matter the chargesheet has been submitted against the petitioner, but he is not certain whether cognizance has not been taken thereon or not.

4. In view of the above, this writ petition is disposed of with direction that till the cognizance is taken on the police report by the court below, petitioner shall not be arrested pursuant to the impugned F.I.R.
Order Date :- 10.4.2024

(Surendra Singh-I, J.) (Siddharth,J.)
